fn HasNoEvenDigit(n: Int) -> Bool
  requires (n == n)
  ensures (result == ((n >= 0) and (((n < 10) and ((n % 2) == 1)) or (((n % 2) == 1) and HasNoEvenDigit((n / 10))))))
  effects pure
  example (HasNoEvenDigit(0) == false)
  example (HasNoEvenDigit(1) == true)
{
  ((n >= 0) and (((n < 10) and ((n % 2) == 1)) or (((n % 2) == 1) and HasNoEvenDigit((n / 10)))))
}

fn UniqueDigits(x: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(x) >= 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): HasNoEvenDigit(result[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): forall j in (i + 1)..len(result): (result[i] <= result[j])
  ensures forall e in x: ((not HasNoEvenDigit(e)) or contains(result, e))
  ensures forall e in result: contains(x, e)
  effects pure
  example (UniqueDigits([]) == [])
{
  []
}
